description: This file contains Redux action creators and related functions for managing thread data in Mattermost, including fetching, updating, marking as read/unread, and handling thread-related state changes.

methods.name: fetchThreads
methods.description: Fetches user threads for a specific team with optional filters like before, after, unread, etc.

methods.name: getThreadsForCurrentTeam
methods.description: Retrieves threads for the current team, including profile and file data, and updates the Redux store.

methods.name: getThreadCounts
methods.description: Fetches total counts of threads, unread threads, mentions, and urgent mentions for a user in a team.

methods.name: getCountsAndThreadsSince
methods.description: Fetches thread counts and threads updated since a given timestamp, batching multiple actions.

methods.name: handleThreadArrived
methods.description: Handles the arrival of a new thread, updating participants, post, and read status in the store.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Fetches a specific thread by ID and processes its arrival.

methods.name: handleAllMarkedRead
methods.description: Marks all threads in a team as read.

methods.name: markAllThreadsInTeamRead
methods.description: Marks all threads in a team as read via API call.

methods.name: markThreadAsUnread
methods.description: Marks a specific thread as unread for a user.

methods.name: markLastPostInThreadAsUnread
methods.description: Marks the last post in a thread as unread, loading posts if necessary.

methods.name: updateThreadRead
methods.description: Updates the read status of a thread for a user.

methods.name: handleReadChanged
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating a thread's read status has changed.

methods.name: handleFollowChanged
methods.description: Dispatches an action indicating a thread's follow status has changed.

methods.name: setThreadFollow
methods.description: Sets the follow/unfollow status of a thread for a user.

methods.name: handleAllThreadsInChannelMarkedRead
methods.description: Marks all threads in a channel as read.

methods.name: decrementThreadCounts
methods.description: Decrements unread reply and mention counts for a thread based on a post.
